name: Smooth muscle cell
failures: Phenotype switching in atherosclerosis, airway remodelling, aneurysm wall failure.

see.note: Imaging shows vessel structure, not cell phenotype.

model.note: Contractile versus synthetic phenotype is a spectrum with no clear set-point.

edit.note: No cell-directed therapy; stents and drugs address consequences.
